sql: UPDATE memory.main.openivm_views SET refresh_in_progress = true WHERE view_name = '__openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_';

WITH
t0_scan (t0_token, t0_island, t0_flagged, t0_openivm_multiplicity) AS (
    SELECT  `token`, `island`, `flagged`, `openivm_multiplicity`
    FROM    `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta_nsc_p2`
    WHERE   (`openivm_timestamp`>=CAST('2026-11-20 06:29:31.420038' AS TIMESTAMP))
),
t1_aggregate (t8_token, t8_island, t8_flagged, t9_openivm_multiplicity) AS (
    SELECT    t0_token, t0_island, t0_flagged, sum(t0_openivm_multiplicity)
    FROM      t0_scan
    GROUP BY  t0_token, t0_island, t0_flagged
),
t2_filter (t8_token, t8_island, t8_flagged, t9_openivm_multiplicity) AS (
    SELECT  t8_token, t8_island, t8_flagged, t9_openivm_multiplicity
    FROM    t1_aggregate
    WHERE   ((t9_openivm_multiplicity) != (0))
),
t3_projection (t8_token, t8_island, t8_flagged, scalar_3) AS (
    SELECT  t8_token, t8_island, t8_flagged, CAST(t9_openivm_multiplicity AS INTEGER)
    FROM    t2_filter
)
INSERT INTO memory.main.openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_ (token, island, flagged, openivm_multiplicity) 
SELECT * FROM t3_projection;

WITH openivm_net AS (
  SELECT token, island, flagged,
    SUM(openivm_multiplicity) AS _net
  FROM memory.main.openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_ WHERE openivm_timestamp > CAST('2026-11-20 06:29:31.420038' AS TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY token, island, flagged
  HAVING SUM(openivm_multiplicity) != 0
)
INSERT INTO memory.main.openivm_data___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_ SELECT token, island, flagged
FROM openivm_net, generate_series(1, CAST(openivm_net._net AS BIGINT))
WHERE openivm_net._net > 0;

CREATE TABLE `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_next___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` AS SELECT v.* FROM (WITH
t0_scan (token, island, flagged) AS (
    SELECT  `token`, `island`, `flagged`
    FROM    `memory`.`main`.`openivm_data___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_`
)
SELECT  token AS `token`, island AS `island`, flagged AS `flagged`,
        CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS `openivm_ordinal`
FROM    t0_scan) v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` d WHERE v.`token` <=> d.`token` AND v.`island` <=> d.`island` AND v.`flagged` <=> d.`flagged`);

CREATE TABLE `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` AS SELECT `token`, `island`, `flagged`, `openivm_ordinal`, SUM(`openivm_publish_weight`) AS `openivm_publish_weight` FROM (SELECT *, CAST(-1 AS BIGINT) AS `openivm_publish_weight` FROM (SELECT v.* FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` d WHERE v.`token` <=> d.`token` AND v.`island` <=> d.`island` AND v.`flagged` <=> d.`flagged`)) old_rows UNION ALL SELECT *, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_next___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_`) signed_rows GROUP BY `token`, `island`, `flagged`, `openivm_ordinal` HAVING SUM(`openivm_publish_weight`) <> 0;

INSERT INTO `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` (`token`, `island`, `flagged`, `openivm_ordinal`, openivm_multiplicity, openivm_timestamp) SELECT c.`token`, c.`island`, c.`flagged`, c.`openivm_ordinal`, CAST(sign(c.`openivm_publish_weight`) AS INTEGER), make_timestamp(epoch_us(current_timestamp())) FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` c LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(CAST(1 AS BIGINT), CAST(abs(c.`openivm_publish_weight`) AS BIGINT))) repetitions AS repetition WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name = 'openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_');

DELETE FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` AS v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` d WHERE v.`token` <=> d.`token` AND v.`island` <=> d.`island` AND v.`flagged` <=> d.`flagged` AND v.`openivm_ordinal` <=> d.`openivm_ordinal`);

INSERT INTO `memory`.`main`.`openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` SELECT v.* FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_next___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` d WHERE v.`token` <=> d.`token` AND v.`island` <=> d.`island` AND v.`flagged` <=> d.`flagged` AND v.`openivm_ordinal` <=> d.`openivm_ordinal`);

DELETE FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_` WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') OR openivm_timestamp < (SELECT MIN(last_update) FROM (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') consumers);

DELETE FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_nsc_p2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_nsc_p2', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_nsc_p2') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') OR openivm_timestamp < (SELECT MIN(last_update) FROM (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_nsc_p2', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_nsc_p2') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') consumers);

UPDATE memory.main.openivm_delta_tables SET last_update = COALESCE((SELECT MAX(openivm_timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 microsecond' FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_nsc_p2), make_timestamp(epoch_us(current_timestamp()))), last_refresh_ts = make_timestamp(epoch_us(current_timestamp())) WHERE view_name = '__openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_' AND table_name = 'openivm_delta_nsc_p2';
UPDATE memory.main.openivm_views SET refresh_in_progress = false WHERE view_name = '__openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6e73635f70325f646e_';
